promotions.title: PowerBank Advance
promotions.content:
GGLBET Exclusive Feature: PowerBank

What is PowerBank?

PowerBank allows you to use your potential Sports winnings to play casino games before your Sports bet is settled.

For example:

  • You place a Sports bet that can potentially win $100.
  • Before the match ends, you can use that $100 PowerBank to play Casino.
  • Once your Sports bet is settled, your final payout will depend on the result of your Sports bet and how much of your PowerBank balance remains.

 

 
How It Works?
  • After placing a Sports bet, open your Open Bets slip.
  • Click Join to use your potential Sports winnings as your available PowerBank Fund.
  • Click Play to select any available Casino games from the list and start to play.

 

 
Possible Outcomes

If You Win from PowerBank

  • Sports Bet Won: You keep your Slot winnings, any remaining PowerBank balance will be paid as your Sports bet winnings.
  • Sports Bet Lost: Your Slot winnings will be cancelled because your original Sports bet lost.

If You Lose from PowerBank

  • Sports Bet Won: Any remaining PowerBank balance will be paid as your Sports bet winnings. If you lose all of your PowerBank balance, there will be no Sports bet winnings left to collect.
  • Sports Bet Lost: There will be no payout because your original Sports bet lost.

 

*PowerBank is an advance of your potential Sports winnings, not free bonus money. The final result always depends on whether your original Sports bet wins or loses.

 

 
General Terms & Conditions:
  • Once you click "Join", your decision is final and cannot be reversed. Cash Out and Edit Bets will no longer be available for this bet slip
  • Each bet slip has its own standalone PowerBank. Potential funds cannot be combined across multiple bet slips.
  • Only Real Money Bets are eligible for the PowerBank feature. Bonus Bets and Free Bets are not eligible
  • If your Sports bet is settled while you are playing casino games, the casino game will automatically end and your winnings (if any) will be paid out.
  • If the original Sports bet is resettled, all PowerBank-related winnings will be forfeited.
  • Only Sports bets with all selections settled as WON are eligible to receive the PowerBank Fund, regardless of whether the player wins or loses while using the PowerBank Fund.
    • If any selection is VOIDED/RETURN, the PowerBank Fund will be forfeited. The bet payout will be calculated based on the original Sports bet result.
  • If all the original Sports bet is settled as VOID/RETURN, the entire PowerBank Fund will be forfeited, and only the original Sports bet stake will be refunded.

      • Edit a multiple bet by removing events to convert it into a single bet.

promotions.title: Cash Out / Free Cancel Bet
promotions.content:
What benefits do you get with this feature?

Have you ever placed a pre-match bet, then changed your mind or spotted a better opportunity and wished you could use your stake elsewhere?

Now you have the unique chance to cancel your bet using Cash Out—with no commission!

If the odds have stayed the same or dropped since you placed your bet, the Cash Out amount will be equal to or greater than your original stake.

 

Cash Out: Secure Your Winnings & Control Your Bets

  • Take full advantage of your bets and minimize potential losses with Cash Out, Partial Cash Out, or Auto Cash Out. These features give you control to settle your bet before an event is finished, allowing you to lock in a profit or cut your losses in real-time.

 

 
What is Cash Out?

Cash Out is an exclusive betting feature that lets you settle your bet for a current value before the event concludes. This amount is based on the real-time probability of your bet winning.

  • How it works: If you choose to Cash Out, the amount offered at that moment is instantly paid to your account.
  • Final result: The actual outcome of the event no longer affects your payout.
  • Offered amount: The Cash Out value depends on the live performance of your selection and can be higher or lower than your original stake.

 

 
When is Cash Out Available & How to Use It?
  • Availability: Cash Out is offered on a variety of sports for selected pre-match and in-play events, on both single and multiple bets.
  • How to Cash Out:
  1. Look for the ($) button or 'Cash Out' label in your 'Open Bets' or 'Bet History'.
  2. Click it to see the current Cash Out offer.
  3. If the ($) is not visible, Cash Out is not available for that bet.
  • Important Note: For pre-match bets on events not covered live, Cash Out will become unavailable once the event starts.
  • Mobile/Tablet: You can also Cash Out easily via our app—navigate to your 'Open Bets' and select the 'Cash Out' tab.

 

 
Types of Cash Out
  1. Full Cash Out
    • Settle your entire bet for the current offered amount. You secure your profit or recovered stake immediately, and the bet is closed.
  2. Partial Cash Out
    • This feature lets you cash out a portion of your bet while leaving the rest to run on the original outcome.
      • How to use: On the Cash Out pop-up, use the slider to select the exact amount you wish to withdraw. Click 'Cash Out' to receive that portion immediately. The remaining stake will be settled based on the final event result.
  3. Auto Cash Out
    • Set a rule to have your bet cashed out automatically when a desired profit threshold is reached.
      • How it works: You set a target Cash Out value. If the live offer meets or exceeds this amount, the system will automatically execute a Full or Partial Cash Out, and the funds will be credited to your account instantly.

 

 
Cash Out Amount Calculation Principles

The offer is calculated based on the current odds of your selection:

  • Case 1: Odds Unchanged
    • If the odds have not changed since you placed the bet, you can Cash Out without any commission, receiving an amount equal to your original stake.
  • Case 2: Odds Decreased
    • ​​​​​​​If the odds have decreased, you will receive an amount equal to or greater than your original stake. This ensures you get at least your stake back, often with a small profit.
  • Case 3: Odds Increased
    • ​​​​​​​If the odds have increased, the Cash Out amount will be lower than your original stake, as an appropriate commission is applied to the improved odds.

*All calculations are performed automatically using a precise mathematical formula.

 

 
Additional Terms & Conditions:

  • The offer is available for Sportsbook and Pre-match only.
  • GGLBET reserves the right to amend or terminate this offer at any time without prior notice.
  • All General Terms and Conditions apply.
